title: TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote fails at base on this shared host: temp tree ticfac-registry-guard-* left behind
description:
Running the full (non-short) internal/cli suite fails at the base commit (verified with my changes stashed) on 'the SIGTERM exit left its temp trees behind: [ticfac-registry-guard-<pid>]'. The test skips under -short, so `make gate` is unaffected, but `make test` on this host fails regardless of any tick's work. Likely the shared-machine-state class learnings already record (7ag: sibling suites write ~/.ticfac/registry mid-gate), i.e. environment, not tree.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding 4072b56812f8956157f430a3bdebcf54c87a7a25aaf2fb88ab9c243ab7379500 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-4nq/attempt-48): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/4072b56812f8956157f430a3bdebcf54c87a7a25aaf2fb88ab9c243ab7379500.json on the run branch.
